The previous placeholder stories have been replaced by the 60 entries in the supplied final document. Individual review status badges have been removed.

The homepage shows automatically changing story cards with pause/next/previous controls.
Experiences page provides country and tour filters plus keyword search.

For live use, ensure guests consent to public naming and that the feedback reflects their actual experiences.
